verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing to ask of a developer-facing banking API platform, so the axis applies. The evidence documents a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, a Postman collection, and SDKs in many languages. The 'Curl' entry in the client-library list is raw HTTP examples, and SDKs are developer building blocks, so neither counts as an official Stark Bank CLI. There is no evidence of a first-party command-line tool.
